testcase.name: the journey: an unseen task the competence cannot carry, the missing prerequisite named, a bounded typed request, an authorised fulfilment that changes the SAME task's disposition, and three refusals
the durable lifecycle: a retirement survives a restart, prevents the stale selection, keeps the historical evidence, and the competence can be revalidated
the retained evidence carries every per-case row and the summary, and the manifest verifies the directory
after a restart the EXACT REVISED procedure serves a DIFFERENT task, the retired one is not offered to the selector, and the user-observable outcome is kept apart from any generalisation claim
the case set is SIX INDEPENDENT authors' work, the slices are disjoint, the nine conditions are covered, and every proposition is a sentence of the corpus
the two rules are measured on IDENTICAL inputs, and the confusion matrix carries every denominator — including the cells that have none
the journey's acquisition metadata is REQUEST-LOCAL: one journey never sees another's, and the resource keeps nothing between requests
